flags.why: The gloss identifies kinh giới (Elsholtzia ciliata), whereas Vietnamese hương nhu refers to Ocimum herbs ([botanical reference](https://vnras.com/huong-nhu-huong-nhu-trang-huong-nhu-tia-nhung-cay-thuoc-va-vi-thuoc-viet-nam-do-tat-loi/)).
flags.fix: fragrant basil herb (Ocimum species, including holy basil and clove basil)

flags.why: Hạ nghĩ sĩ is a spelling error rather than a valid word for a lower-house member.
flags.fix: Correct the headword and example to hạ nghị sĩ; gloss: member of a lower house.

flags.why: Hạ thuỷ means launching a vessel into the water, including its launch ceremony, rather than christening it before launch ([dictionary definition](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/hạ_thủy)).
flags.fix: Remove sense 2 and retain its example under sense 1.
